title: MemTrace 2.1.0 REST bodies
description: Normative MemTrace G1-G5 and Day 7 public-release REST request and response bodies.

Timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp; serialized values use a Z suffix.

TaskCreateRequest.description: The server trims task_text before enforcing 1..20000 Unicode scalar values. The task domain is derived server-side; clients must not send scenario. Effective memory is off when either memory_mode is off or current_constraints.memory_disabled is true.

reason.description: Curated explanation; must not contain source code.

message.description: Curated public message; never an upstream response body.

TaskSnapshot.description: Authoritative G0/G1 recovery snapshot. Clients merge it monotonically by UTF-8 byte end_offset and always fetch it after a terminal SSE event.

ReadyResponse.description: Returned only with HTTP 200. A readiness failure uses ErrorResponse with HTTP 503. Provider network remains unchecked; database connectivity and the unique Alembic head are required.

message.description: Curated safe message; never includes credentials, request headers, or an upstream response body.

SseCursorQuery.description: Query parameters for a manually reconstructed EventSource URL. Explicit after_event_seq takes precedence over Last-Event-ID; both values default to zero.

MemoryKindV2.title: MemoryKindV2
MemoryKindV2.description: User-visible memory kinds in v2. Only three categories.

MemoryEventPayload.title: MemoryEventPayload
MemoryEventPayload.description: Base for memory events. Never contains user content, reasoning, or keys.
